messages:
ashley: Heads up — large provisioning hang in ap-southeast1 after the BMC firmware push overnight. ~80 nodes stuck in 'waiting for oob console', GPU realtime pool empty. Anyone oncall?

sre-bot: [automated] Incident created: INC-2026-1021 - ap-southeast1 provisioning surge (severity: high)

mike: Thanks. Can you paste a sample node id + last oob logs? Also which firmware image was pushed?

ashley: sample node: rack-apse1-12-0345. Logs show repeated keepalive drops + serial rate-limit: 
```
OOB: keepalive=0x00 -> timeout
serial: tx rate limited, dropped 120 packets in 30s
state: WAIT_FOR_CONSOLE
```
Firmware tag: bmc-fw-v2.3.1-2026-03-19 (from deploy-bot)

jia: I saw a single-node repro in staging last week — v2.3.1 toggles the BMC keepalive interval to 0 (edge case) on boards with older PMIC. That makes the controller mark consoles dead. Not secureboot change, it's an oob heartbeat drift.

oliver: We can force a soft-reset of BMC on affected nodes: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** bmc reset cold` but that will drop any running console sessions. Recommend rolling into a canary set first.

ashley: Can we fallback to the previous image (v2.3.0) for the fleet? We need to free GPU capacity ASAP — jobs are queuing and customers hitting SLOs.

oncall-liz: I'm on it. Plan: 1) Pause further bmc-fw rollouts. 2) Trigger rollback for the last batch (tags deployed between 03:00-05:00 UTC). 3) Run `oob-heal.sh` on stuck nodes (soft bmc reset + health-check). 4) Reroute new realtime allocations to eu-west-1 until ap-southeast stabilizes. Need thumbs from eng-infra.

mike: :thumbsup: approve reroute. Cost note — spinning extra capacity in eu-west will increase monthly GPU spend; finance notified.

deploy-bot: Rollback job scheduled: rollback-batch-1719999100 -> rolling to 80 nodes, parallelism=12

jia: Quick mitigation patch: change keepalive default to 15s and add a PMIC fingerprint check. Patch diff: 
```diff
- keepalive_interval = 0
+ keepalive_interval = 15
+ if pmic_version < 3: set_fingerprint_compat()
```
This avoids false positives while we validate the v2.3.x sequence.

ashley: Running `oob-heal.sh rack-apse1-12-0{30..50}` now. I'll post progress. If rollback goes well, start letting queued jobs drain into ap-southeast again.

oncall-liz: Rollback started at 1719999100. First 12 nodes passed health checks within 40s. Monitoring GPU pool reclaim.

oliver: FYI, a few nodes required a full bmc reflash (manual) — flagged and moved to the maintenance pool to avoid repeated churn.

mike: Please log all maintenance actions to the provisioning ticket — we'll need a postmortem on release gating and an ops runbook tweak for future pushes.

ashley: Recovery: 68/80 recovered, GPU realtime pool back to 85% capacity. Leaving 12 in maintenance. Thanks team — will follow up with RCA notes and a temp hold on automated bmc rollouts. :pray:
